decisions.decision: The applicant (EPG Solar) is to return to the May 14 Planning Board meeting with a revised landscaping plan; the Board asked for mounding at various heights, low planting in front, climbing plants on the fence, and ground-view rendering illustrations.

decisions.decision: The Board does not want a continuous straight line of screening; the applicant is to consider mounding with various heights.
